arabic:
مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
۞
يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation: “He set the two seas flowing, meeting side by side; between them a barrier they do not overstep. From both of them come forth the pearl and the coral.”

sunni.label: Sunni emphasis
sunni.body: Classical Sunni tafsir reads a wonder of creation: two seas meet, a barrier keeps each itself, and from them God brings pearl and coral, a favor to ponder.

shia.label: Shia emphasis
shia.body: Shia tafsir carries a narration: the two seas that meet are ʿAlī and Fāṭima, the barrier between them the Prophet, and the pearl and coral their sons al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn.

voiceover.hook: Two seas that meet. A pearl, a coral. One tradition reads them as the Prophet's own family.
voiceover.reference: Surah al-Rahman, verses nineteen, twenty, and twenty-two.
voiceover.payoff: Same words. Different depths. One tradition hears a wonder of the sea; the other hears the Prophet's own family.
voiceover.question: Which of these two readings resonates with you

cta_text: Which of these two readings resonates with you?
caption_desc: Two seas, a pearl, and a coral - one passage of the Qur'an, read two ways for a thousand years 🌙 #quran #tafsir #shia #sunni #ahlulbayt #surahrahman
